name: Tallow
siboNotes: Pure animal fats are well-tolerated on SIBO diets as they contain no fermentable carbohydrates. High in saturated fat, so use in moderation.
preparationTips: Store solidified tallow at room temperature or refrigerate for longer storage
Heat gently to liquid form for cooking - excellent for high-temperature frying
Strain homemade tallow through cheesecloth to remove any remaining protein particles
Can be used as a butter substitute for those avoiding dairy
nutritionalHighlights: Contains fat-soluble vitamins A, D, E, K
